what is jarvis: JARVIS (Just A Rather Very Intelligent System) is an AI assistant created by Tony Stark in Iron Man. It controls Stark's suit, home, and helps with daily tasks.
who made jarvis: Tony Stark (Iron Man) created JARVIS in the Marvel Cinematic Universe.
jarvis full form: JARVIS stands for Just A Rather Very Intelligent System.

arduino.what is arduino: Arduino is an open-source electronics platform based on easy-to-use hardware and software. It can read inputs and turn them into outputs.
arduino.arduino uno: Arduino Uno is the most popular Arduino board. It has 14 digital pins, 6 analog pins, 32KB flash memory, and uses ATmega328P microcontroller.
arduino.arduino nano: Arduino Nano is a small, breadboard-friendly version of Arduino. Same features as Uno but smaller size.
arduino.how to upload code to arduino: 1. Connect Arduino via USB. 2. Open Arduino IDE. 3. Select Board and Port. 4. Click Upload button.
arduino.what is breadboard: A breadboard is a construction base for prototyping electronics. It allows you to build circuits without soldering.

programming.what is python: Python is a high-level, interpreted programming language known for its simplicity and readability. Used in web dev, AI, data science, automation.
programming.what is c++: C++ is a powerful general-purpose programming language. It's used in game development, system programming, and competitive programming.
programming.what is java: Java is a class-based, object-oriented programming language. It's used in Android apps, enterprise software, and web applications.
programming.what is javascript: JavaScript is a programming language used to create interactive web pages. It runs in browsers and on servers (Node.js).
programming.what is html: HTML (HyperText Markup Language) is the standard language for creating web pages. It defines the structure of a webpage.
programming.what is css: CSS (Cascading Style Sheets) is used to style and layout web pages. It controls colors, fonts, spacing, and positioning.

science.what is physics: Physics is the study of matter, energy, motion, and force. It explains how the universe works from subatomic particles to galaxies.
science.what is chemistry: Chemistry is the study of substances - what they're made of, how they interact, and what rules they follow.
science.what is biology: Biology is the study of living organisms - their structure, function, growth, evolution, and distribution.
science.what is gravity: Gravity is a force that attracts objects toward each other. On Earth, it gives weight to objects and causes them to fall when dropped.
science.what is electricity: Electricity is the flow of electric charge. It powers our homes, devices, and is essential for modern civilization.
science.what is internet: The Internet is a global network of interconnected computers that communicate using standardized protocols. It enables email, web browsing, and more.

general.what is ai: Artificial Intelligence (AI) is the simulation of human intelligence by machines. It includes learning, reasoning, problem-solving, and decision-making.
general.what is machine learning: Machine Learning is a subset of AI where systems learn from data without being explicitly programmed. Examples: recommendation systems, image recognition.
general.what is wifi: WiFi is a wireless networking technology that allows devices to connect to the internet without physical cables. It uses radio waves.
general.what is bluetooth: Bluetooth is a wireless technology for exchanging data over short distances between devices. Used in headphones, speakers, and file transfers.
general.what is blockchain: Blockchain is a distributed ledger technology that records transactions across many computers. It's the foundation of cryptocurrencies like Bitcoin.

home_automation.what is home automation: Home automation refers to controlling home devices automatically using technology. It includes lighting, security, climate control, and appliances.
home_automation.what is iot: Internet of Things (IoT) is the network of physical devices connected to the internet. Smart home devices, wearables, and sensors are examples.
home_automation.what is esp32: ESP32 is a low-cost, low-power microcontroller with built-in WiFi and Bluetooth. It's perfect for IoT and home automation projects.
home_automation.what is arduino home automation: Using Arduino boards to control home devices like lights, fans, doors, and sensors. Can be controlled via phone, voice, or automation.

hindi.namaste kya hai: Namaste is a traditional Hindi greeting meaning Hello. It is used to greet someone respectfully.
hindi.bharat desh hai: Bharat (India) is a country in South Asia. It is the world's most populous country and the 7th largest by area.
hindi.hindi kya hai: Hindi is an Indo-Aryan language spoken primarily in India. It is one of the official languages of the Indian government.
